maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from ExtraCash advances, express fees and banking for consumers, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumer members via express fees, tips and subscriptions, plus bank interchange; not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by adding members to its ExtraCash app and banking products; no steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other cash advance or banking apps; small short-term advances, low switching cost.
